rationale: The requested refactor affects runtime-contract architecture and all consumers, which rules out the lightweight paths, but the evidence needed to distinguish structured_slice from structured_delivery is absent. Missing approvals and Brownfield routing must be treated fail-closed.
decision_grounds: No approved and durable UR is evidenced.
No completed Brownfield Review or evidenced Mode/Slice Decision is provided.
The monolithic runtime contract is an architectural owner, and migrating all consumers implies cross-owner or broad-path
quick_task and trivial_change are ineligible because plugin/meta/** and likely executable consumers are in scope.
compact_delivery is unsupported because there is no approved UR, completed Brownfield analysis, or stored quick_task con
verified_change is unsupported because one canonical owner, bounded clean-at-baseline paths, prohibited-impact absence,
The available evidence does not safely choose between structured_slice and structured_delivery.
